dedupe_keys.name: global maps of area suitability for solar photovoltaics on rooftops and cropland

description: This dataset gives global maps of the area suitable for solar photovoltaics on building rooftops and on cropland (agrivoltaics). It was published on Zenodo by Madhura Yeligeti, Wenxuan Hu, Yvonne Scholz, Ronald Stegen and Kai von Krbek of the German Aerospace Center (DLR) Institute of Networked Energy Systems in Stuttgart; version 1.1 is dated 1 February 2023. It contains a rooftop suitability factor map, the percentage of PV-suitable building area in each cell, and agrivoltaic suitability for three scenarios of policy and social acceptance (optimistic, neutral and conservative), all at about 10 by 10 kilometres. The maps are based on Copernicus Land Monitoring Service land cover for 2019 and OpenStreetMap accessed in 2021; version 1.1 revised the agrivoltaic method to include regional crop differences. Coverage: global. Access: five GeoTIFF files of about 27 to 29 MB each on Zenodo; the concept DOI groups versions. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: coarse resolution, and rooftop area relies on OpenStreetMap completeness. Simulation uses: rooftop PV potential in energy system models. Related records: the rooftop area SSP projections and the EU building density map.
